_published_faq.name: How do I add Descope for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Descope for Claude to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.descope.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Descope for Claude MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Descope for Claude scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Descope for Claude MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Descope for Claude lists 23 MCP tools, including access_control_read, access_control_write, agentic_read, agentic_write, audits_read, auth_keys_read, auth_keys_write, connect_read, connect_write, docs_ask_question, docs_search, and flows_read.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Descope for Claude in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
